usage_notes: Station docs captured 2026-08-17; read-only per-token catalog observation captured 2026-08-18. No completion probe, forwarder smoke, or deployed gateway smoke has run against this endpoint yet.

OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api.aigocode.com/v1 with Authorization: Bearer. Third-party references to api.aigocode.app exist and also serve the catalog; only the docs-published api.aigocode.com host is allowlisted here and any live mismatch will fail closed.

Per-vendor tokens are mandatory: catalog scoping verified read-only 2026-08-18 across the four operator-created tokens (CODEX_1.2 -> 7 OpenAI-side models, CLAUDE_3.9 -> 9 Claude models, GROK_2.5 -> 2 grok models, GEMINI_1 -> 4 gemini models; zero cross-vendor visibility). Profiles bind the matching credential variable per vendor group.

Station WAF blocks generic Python User-Agents with Cloudflare error 1010; browser-style and OpenAI-SDK-style UAs pass (verified 2026-08-18, read-only). The gateway/probe HTTP stack must be confirmed live before qualification.

Broker/relay endpoint: the station docs state console and server-side configuration always take precedence over the published model list, so requested/reported identity must be verified by live catalog and probes for every model.
No per-token station prices are public (console login wall), so no pricing files exist for this provider and ledger cost estimates are intentionally unknown.
